blocks.text: Sulfonamides synthetic dawai compounds hain jo sulfanilamide se bane; kitab in ki daryaft Gerhard Domagk (1932) se jorti hai. Yeh antimicrobial (jaraseem ke khilaf) dawaen hain jo bacteria mein folate (folic acid) banna rok kar infections ka ilaaj karti hain, khaas taur par peshab ki nali ke infections (urinary tract infections) aur jild ke infections. Yeh competitive inhibitors (muqabla kar ke enzyme rokne wali) aur bacteriostatic antibiotics hain jo bacteria mein folic acid banna rokti hain; folic acid DNA banne aur bacteria ki growth ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh aksar munh se di jati hain, aur in ke kuch side effects hain: daane (rashes), matli, roshni se hassasiyat (photosensitivity) aur gurde ka nuqsan.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Normal: PABA bacterial enzyme ki jagah mein fit hota hai, teer 'folic acid made' tak, phir 'DNA, growth'. Sulfonamide: sulfonamide wahi jagah le leti hai, teer 'no folic acid' tak, phir 'growth stops'.
blocks.caption: Sulfonamide PABA se enzyme ki jagah ke liye muqabla (competitive inhibition) karti hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

items: Bacteriostatic asar: yeh bacteria ko foran nahi maarti balke un ki growth rok deti hain, taa ke jism ka immune system unhein khatam kar de.

Selective toxicity (sirf bacteria ke liye zehreela pan): bacteria ko folate (aik zaroori vitamin) khud shuru se banana parta hai, jabke insan ise khurak se jazb kar lete hain. Is liye dawa bacteria ko is zaroori ghizai juz se mehroom kar deti hai aur insani cells ko kuch nahi kehti.

Competitive inhibition: sulfonamides shakal mein para-aminobenzoic acid (PABA) jaisi hain. Yeh folate banane wale bacterial enzyme se jur jati hain aur PABA ki jagah le kar folate banne ka raasta (folate metabolism) band kar deti hain.
Combined therapy (mila jula ilaaj): aksar inhein trimethoprim jaisi doosri dawaon ke saath milaya jata hai, jis se zyada taqatwar bactericidal (bacteria maarne wala) asar milta hai.

Broad spectrum (wasee daira): yeh Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono bacteria par kaam karti hain, aur aksar peshab ki nali ke infections, keel muhason (acne) aur saans ke infections mein istemal hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Sulfonamides sirf bacteria ke liye zehreeli kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Bacteria ko PABA se folate khud banana parta hai, aur yahi qadam dawa rokti hai. Insani cells folate khurak se lete hain aur yeh raasta istemal nahi karte.

items: PABA se muqabla kar ke folate banna rokti hain; aksar trimethoprim ke saath; broad spectrum.
